question_reviews.question: Resolve Esma Ertel’s own musical associations and verify Studio Gam’s location; do not copy Murat Ertel’s history to her.

question_reviews.question: The white-label EP is not an identified edition of the full Companionship album. Match takes before transferring session credits.

question_reviews.question: Locate South Central Studios; only the explicit Berlin re-recording is accepted.

question_reviews.question: The source names only Europe; city-level sessions remain unresolved.
